creators.name: Inna Horobchuk
creators.role: Architect turned creative technologist; Snap Spectacles Lens developer
creators.bio: Trained as an architect and interior designer, she now builds AR Lenses for Snapchat and Spectacles, often with Volodymyr Kurbatov, including Wi-Fi Speed, AviaSpy, Tarot, Star Map and an origami tutor.
creators.why: She makes invisible or abstract things legible in the room, from Wi-Fi coverage to decision fatigue, and won Snap's Lensathon 2025 and several Spectacles Community Challenges with them.
creators.role_zh: 建筑师出身的创意技术专家；Snap Spectacles Lens 开发者
creators.bio_zh: 她受过建筑和室内设计训练，如今为 Snapchat 和 Spectacles 制作 AR Lens，常与 Volodymyr Kurbatov 合作，作品包括 Wi-Fi Speed、AviaSpy、Tarot、Star Map 以及一个折纸教学 Lens。
creators.why_zh: 她擅长把看不见或抽象的东西在房间里变得可读，从 Wi-Fi 覆盖到决策疲劳，并凭这些作品赢得 Snap Lensathon 2025 和多次 Spectacles Community Challenge。

creators.name: Krunal Gediya
creators.role: AR developer and creative technologist (All Things Krazyy)
creators.bio: Mumbai-based Lens Studio developer who builds games, utilities and hardware hacks for Snapchat and Spectacles, from Color Rush and AirTouch to Remote ARsistance and the LED-dress performance Lucid Weave.
creators.why: He keeps connecting Spectacles to the physical world (smart homes, RC cars, laptop screens, wearable LEDs) and won two Lens Fest 2025 Awards and repeated Spectacles Community Challenge prizes.
creators.role_zh: AR 开发者、创意技术专家（All Things Krazyy）
creators.bio_zh: 常驻孟买的 Lens Studio 开发者，为 Snapchat 和 Spectacles 制作游戏、实用工具和硬件实验，作品从 Color Rush、AirTouch 到 Remote ARsistance，以及 LED 连衣裙表演 Lucid Weave。
creators.why_zh: 他不断把 Spectacles 与物理世界连接起来（智能家居、遥控车、笔记本屏幕、可穿戴灯带），获得两项 Lens Fest 2025 大奖，并多次在 Spectacles Community Challenge 中获奖。

creators.name: Lafiya Watson Ramirez (Bad Chick Studios)
creators.role: Multidisciplinary artist and AR developer; founder of Bad Chick Studios
creators.bio: Artist working across AR design and development, web and photography; after a Snapchat artist residency in 2020 she built early Spectacles games, the location-based AR piece Stolen Rainbow (chosen for Niantic Lightship's sample library) and AR filters for the Museum of the City of New York.
creators.why: Her interactive storytelling uses wearable AR for ritual and memory, as in Wage Love, where gestures and voice summon ancestors who leave flowers behind.
creators.role_zh: 跨学科艺术家、AR 开发者；Bad Chick Studios 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 她的创作横跨 AR 设计与开发、网页和摄影；2020 年参加 Snapchat 艺术家驻留后，她做过早期的 Spectacles 游戏、入选 Niantic Lightship 示例库的地点 AR 作品 Stolen Rainbow，以及为纽约市博物馆制作的 AR 滤镜。
creators.why_zh: 她用可穿戴 AR 讲述关于仪式与记忆的互动故事，比如 Wage Love：手势和声音召唤出先祖，他们走过之处留下鲜花。

creators.name: Calvin Dong (Thanh Hung Dong)
creators.bio: Spectacles developer who, with Lien Tran as the Mooncake Media team, made the dollhouse-decorating Lens Dream Home, and who co-created the photo-hole party game Pic Seeker at Specs in the City Paris 2025.
creators.why: Pic Seeker shows how passing a single pair of glasses from hand to hand can itself be a game mechanic.
creators.bio_zh: Spectacles 开发者，曾与 Lien Tran 以 Mooncake Media 团队名义制作装修娃娃屋的 Lens Dream Home，并在 Specs in the City Paris 2025 黑客松上参与创作了“照片挖洞”派对游戏 Pic Seeker。
creators.why_zh: Pic Seeker 说明，把一副眼镜在人与人之间传递，本身就可以成为一种游戏机制。

creators.name: Awu Chen, Suvi Helin & Matti Grüner
creators.bio: Team of three who met at MIT Reality Hack 2026; Suvi Helin came from Unity and learned Lens Studio during the event, and together they built Wake Them Up!, a Spectacles Lens in which objects tell stories about their owner.
creators.why: Their prompt design kept Gemini in character as a storyteller instead of a helpful assistant, a useful lesson in using AI for narrative rather than utility.
creators.role_zh: MIT Reality Hack 2026 参赛团队
creators.bio_zh: 三人在 MIT Reality Hack 2026 上组队；Suvi Helin 原本使用 Unity，在比赛期间学会了 Lens Studio，三人共同完成了 Wake Them Up!：一个让物品讲述主人故事的 Spectacles Lens。
creators.why_zh: 他们通过提示词设计让 Gemini 始终扮演讲故事的人，而不是热心助手，为“用 AI 讲故事而非提供功能”提供了可借鉴的经验。

creators.name: Kshitij Kumar Parashar (with Brian Chung, Liza Karimova & Timera)
creators.role: XR developer; Specs in the City NYC 2025 team Spectacular Suspects
creators.bio: Developer who, with teammates Brian Chung, Liza Karimova and Timera, built the co-located party game Who AR You? for Spectacles at Snap's Specs in the City NYC hackathon in May 2025.
creators.why: Their game finds a social use of shared AR that only glasses can offer: information that everyone can see except the person wearing it above their head.
creators.role_zh: XR 开发者；Specs in the City NYC 2025 参赛团队 Spectacular Suspects
creators.bio_zh: 他与队友 Brian Chung、Liza Karimova 和 Timera 在 2025 年 5 月 Snap 举办的 Specs in the City NYC 黑客松上，为 Spectacles 开发了同场派对游戏 Who AR You?。
creators.why_zh: 他们的游戏为共享 AR 找到了一种只有眼镜才能实现的社交用法：一条除了头顶着它的当事人以外所有人都能看到的信息。

creators.name: Steven Harmon & Team Time Travellers
creators.role: XR developer; MIT Reality Hack 2026 team
creators.bio: Team of Steven Harmon, Syed Akbar, Sara Jakubowicz, Ryan Bose-Roy and Alex Diviney that combined Spectacles with a custom ESP32 watch-radio to build The Time Dial at MIT Reality Hack 2026.
creators.why: Their tactile dial, inspired by science-fiction time devices, gives geolocated photo archives a physical, playful way in.
creators.role_zh: XR 开发者；MIT Reality Hack 2026 参赛团队
creators.bio_zh: 团队成员包括 Steven Harmon、Syed Akbar、Sara Jakubowicz、Ryan Bose-Roy 和 Alex Diviney，他们在 MIT Reality Hack 2026 上把 Spectacles 和一个定制的 ESP32 腕表收音机结合起来，做出了 The Time Dial。
creators.why_zh: 他们受科幻作品中时间装置启发设计的实体旋钮，为带地理信息的老照片档案提供了一种可触摸、好玩的入口。

creators.name: Markus Lanxinger, Marco van Nieuwenhoven & Jiayao Yu
creators.role: Founder of Plinth; 3EALITY & Spectacles Hackathon team
creators.bio: Markus Lanxinger, founder of Plinth B.V. and Lightfield Industries in The Hague, built Postmark with Marco van Nieuwenhoven and Jiayao Yu, whose Input Paradigms Lens explores voice, raycast and hand-based menus on Spectacles.
creators.why: Postmark shows that spatial computing works best when it respects attention: quiet objects that wait until you look at them.
creators.role_zh: Plinth 创始人；3EALITY & Spectacles 黑客松团队
creators.bio_zh: Markus Lanxinger 是海牙 Plinth B.V. 和 Lightfield Industries 的创始人，他与 Marco van Nieuwenhoven 和 Jiayao Yu 一起做了 Postmark；Jiayao Yu 还做过 Input Paradigms Lens，探索 Spectacles 上的语音、射线和手部菜单交互。
creators.why_zh: Postmark 说明空间计算在尊重注意力时效果最好：那些安静等待、直到你看向它们才开口的物件。

creators.name: Bob Bjarke (The Electric Factory)
creators.role: Creative director at The Electric Factory
creators.bio: Creative director with more than a decade at advertising agencies (Leo Burnett, Team One, RPA, Chiat) and several years at Facebook, Instagram and Meta, now at the creative technology company The Electric Factory, specialising in AR, VR and AI.
creators.why: His basketball Lens is a clean example of pulling outside-world data onto the exact real place it describes.
creators.role_zh: The Electric Factory 创意总监
creators.bio_zh: 创意总监，在 Leo Burnett、Team One、RPA、Chiat 等广告公司工作十余年，又在 Facebook、Instagram 和 Meta 任职数年，现就职于创意科技公司 The Electric Factory，专注 AR、VR 和 AI。
creators.why_zh: 他的篮球 Lens 是一个干净利落的范例：把外部世界的数据叠回它所描述的那个真实场地上。

creators.name: Pieter Siekerman (Siekerman Technology)
creators.bio: Amsterdam developer who builds geospatial AR with open city data across Snap Spectacles, 8th Wall, Niantic Lightship and ARCore, including the open-source Snap OS Location Tools, TransitView and the Reality Import platform.
creators.why: He keeps showing what GPS, compass and public data can do on glasses, from city data overlays to buses seen through buildings.
creators.bio_zh: 阿姆斯特丹的开发者，利用开放城市数据在 Snap Spectacles、8th Wall、Niantic Lightship 和 ARCore 上开发地理空间 AR，作品包括开源的 Snap OS Location Tools、TransitView 和 Reality Import 平台。
creators.why_zh: 他不断展示 GPS、指南针和公共数据在眼镜上能做什么，从城市数据叠加到“透过楼房看到公交车”。

creators.name: Harry Banda
creators.role: Software developer and Spectacles game maker
creators.bio: Zambian developer and serial hackathon builder whose Spectacles Lenses include Card Master, Pixel Builder, Jigsaw Genie, MathBee and Memory Grid; Card Master won Best Spectacles Lens at Lens Fest 2025.
creators.why: He turns classic games and puzzles into well-tuned spatial play, and Memory Grid shows how simply asking players to walk can change a familiar mechanic.
creators.role_zh: 软件开发者、Spectacles 游戏制作者
creators.bio_zh: 赞比亚开发者，常年参加黑客松，他的 Spectacles Lens 包括 Card Master、Pixel Builder、Jigsaw Genie、MathBee 和 Memory Grid；其中 Card Master 获得 Lens Fest 2025 最佳 Spectacles Lens 奖。
creators.why_zh: 他把经典游戏和益智玩法打磨成手感出色的空间游戏，Memory Grid 说明只要让玩家走起来，熟悉的玩法就会焕然一新。

works.title: Decisionator
works.description: Point at two real things, such as two snacks or two shirts, and the Lens picks one for you without hesitation, using your profile, the weather, the time of day and your past choices. Built in about 24 hours by Inna Horobchuk, Volodymyr Kurbatov, Candice Branchereau and Marcin Polakowski, it won the Spectacles track of Snap's Lensathon 2025.
works.description_zh: 用手指向两样真实的东西，比如两包零食或两件衬衫，Lens 会毫不犹豫地替你选一个，依据是你的个人档案、天气、时间和你以往的选择。作品由 Inna Horobchuk、Volodymyr Kurbatov、Candice Branchereau 和 Marcin Polakowski 在约 24 小时内完成，获得 Snap Lensathon 2025 Spectacles 赛道第一名。
works.idea_en: Hand your small daily choices to an AI, and ask how much of yourself you are willing to delegate.
works.idea_zh: 把日常的小决定交给 AI，借此追问：我们愿意把多少“自我”交出去？
works.technique: Each camera frame goes to Gemini, which returns bounding boxes for the two pointed-at objects plus a verdict; a depth cache places the answer in 3D, and a Supabase profile (zodiac sign, diet, history) feeds the reasoning so different wearers get different decisions.
works.technique_zh: 每帧画面发送给 Gemini，返回被指向的两个物体的边界框和选择结果；深度缓存把答案放回三维空间，Supabase 中保存的个人档案（星座、饮食、历史选择）参与推理，因此不同的人会得到不同的决定。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone or WebXR prototype where the user frames two objects with the camera and a vision-language model must choose one and justify it in one sentence; test it on classmates' lunches. Twist: let a whole table share one profile so the glasses decide for the group.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机或 WebXR 做一个原型：用户用摄像头框住两样东西，视觉语言模型必须选一个并用一句话说明理由，拿同学的午餐来测试。变体：让一桌人共享一个档案，由眼镜替整桌人做决定。

works.title: Lucid Weave
works.description: A performer sculpts melodies in the air with hand gestures; each phrase appears as a volumetric light trail in the glasses and, at the same moment, pulses across a custom LED dress the performer is wearing. Built at MIT Reality Hack 2026 by Krunal Gediya, Abraham Pacheco, Meghna S and Aishah G, it won Best Hardware there and later an open-source prize in Spectacles Community Challenge #9.
works.description_zh: 表演者用手势在空中塑造旋律；每段乐句在眼镜里化作立体光迹，同时在表演者身上定制的 LED 连衣裙上脉动。作品由 Krunal Gediya、Abraham Pacheco、Meghna S 和 Aishah G 在 MIT Reality Hack 2026 完成，获最佳硬件奖，之后又获得 Spectacles Community Challenge #9 开源组奖项。
works.idea_en: Music you paint in the air should also be worn on the body that made it.
works.idea_zh: 在空中画出的音乐，也应该穿在创造它的身体上。
works.technique: Spectacles hand tracking maps gesture position to the pitch and timbre of a synthesiser, while note events are relayed with low latency to an ESP32-S3 that drives addressable RGB LEDs sewn into the dress.
works.technique_zh: Spectacles 的手部追踪把手势位置映射为合成器的音高和音色，音符事件以低延迟转发给 ESP32-S3，由它驱动缝在裙子里的可寻址 RGB 灯带。
works.exercise_en: Map hand height to pitch in a WebXR or phone hand-tracking sketch and send each note over WebSocket to a microcontroller with an LED strip sewn onto a sleeve. Twist: let a second person's gestures light up the first person's garment.
works.exercise_zh: 在 WebXR 或手机手部追踪草图中把手的高度映射为音高，并通过 WebSocket 把每个音符发送给带 LED 灯带的单片机，灯带缝在袖子上。变体：让第二个人的手势去点亮第一个人身上的衣服。

works.title: Wage Love: Ancestral Dance
works.description: Mother Earth asks for help: through three guided interactions you call forth ancestor spirits with your voice and hands, watch them dance, and place your palm on the ground to share love, while trails of flowers bloom wherever they step. Made with Dulce Baerga at the Reality Hack x Snap hackathon at AWE 2025 and inspired by Sultan Sharrief's Wage Love, it later placed third in Spectacles Community Challenge #3 and can be shared by several players.
works.description_zh: 大地母亲在求助：通过三段引导式互动，你用声音和双手召唤先祖之灵，看他们起舞，再把手掌贴在地面传递爱意，他们走过的地方会开出一路鲜花。作品由 Lafiya Watson Ramirez 与 Dulce Baerga 在 AWE 2025 的 Reality Hack x Snap 黑客松上完成，灵感来自 Sultan Sharrief 的 Wage Love，后获 Spectacles Community Challenge #3 新 Lens 组第三名，可多人同时体验。
works.idea_en: A shared ritual of remembrance in which your gestures and voice summon ancestors who leave flowers behind them.
works.idea_zh: 一场共同的追思仪式：你的手势和声音召唤出先祖，他们走过之处留下鲜花。
works.technique: Hand tracking and voice recognition trigger each step of the ritual, animated spirit figures follow scripted dance paths that spawn flower particles, and Connected Lenses sync the scene between participants.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪和语音识别触发仪式的每一步，动画化的灵体沿预设舞蹈路径移动并生成花朵粒子，Connected Lenses 在参与者之间同步场景。
works.exercise_en: Design a three-step AR ritual on a phone in which a spoken word, a hand pose and touching the floor each unlock the next scene; perform it as a group. Twist: the ritual completes only if two people make the final gesture at the same time.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机上设计一个三步 AR 仪式：说出一个词、摆出一个手势、触碰地面，每一步解锁下一幕；以小组形式完成。变体：只有两个人同时做出最后一个手势，仪式才算完成。

works.title: Pic Seeker
works.description: One player snaps a photo of part of the room, which cuts a hole in reality; then they pass the Spectacles to the next player, who must walk, stretch and crouch to find the real spot that fills the missing piece. Made at Specs in the City Paris 2025, where it placed third, by a team including Calvin Dong and Vitaly Protago.
works.description_zh: 一名玩家拍下房间某处的照片，现实中就被“挖”出一个洞；随后他把 Spectacles 递给下一位玩家，对方得走动、伸展、蹲下，找到能补上这块缺口的真实位置。作品由 Calvin Dong、Vitaly Protago 等人组成的团队在 Specs in the City Paris 2025 黑客松上完成，获第三名。
works.idea_en: A photo becomes a missing puzzle piece of the room, and handing over the glasses becomes the turn-taking mechanic.
works.idea_zh: 一张照片变成房间缺失的一块拼图，而把眼镜递给下一个人，就是轮流的玩法。
works.technique: A captured camera frame is likely placed as a textured cut-out at the pose where it was taken; the next player's viewpoint is compared with that pose, and a match within a position and angle tolerance completes the round.
works.technique_zh: 拍下的画面很可能以带贴图的镂空形式放在拍摄时的位置和朝向上；系统将下一位玩家的视角与该位姿比较，位置和角度在容差范围内即判定完成。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, save the camera pose and a screenshot, show the screenshot as a floating frame elsewhere, and challenge a partner to find the exact viewpoint. Twist: the photo must be taken from a child's or a dog's eye height.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中保存相机位姿和截图，把截图作为漂浮画框放在别处，让同伴找出完全相同的视角。变体：照片要从小孩或小狗的视线高度拍摄。

works.title: Wake Them Up!
works.description: Look around a room and glowing dots hover over its objects; touch one and the object tells you a dream or memory about its owner, so a stranger's life is pieced together from their mug, chair and books. Built at MIT Reality Hack 2026 by Awu Chen, Suvi Helin and Matti Grüner.
works.description_zh: 环顾房间，物品上方浮现发光的小点；触碰其中一个，这件物品就会讲述一段关于主人的梦或回忆，于是一个陌生人的一生从他的杯子、椅子和书里被拼凑出来。作品由 Awu Chen、Suvi Helin 和 Matti Grüner 在 MIT Reality Hack 2026 完成。
works.idea_en: Let the objects in a room remember their owner and speak for someone who is no longer there.
works.idea_zh: 让房间里的物品记得它们的主人，替一个已不在场的人开口。
works.technique: Gemini labels objects in a captured frame and returns their world positions, while a narrative engine on Snap Cloud edge functions holds one stored persona and generates cross-referenced dreams for each newly recognised object.
works.technique_zh: Gemini 识别截取画面中的物体并返回它们在世界中的位置，Snap Cloud 边缘函数上的叙事引擎保存一个固定人物设定，为每个新识别的物体生成相互呼应的梦境故事。
works.exercise_en: Write a fictional owner for a room, then use phone AR with an image-recognition model to attach a short first-person memory to each of five objects. Twist: two objects remember the same event differently.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个房间虚构一位主人，再用手机 AR 加图像识别模型，为五件物品各配上一段第一人称的简短回忆。变体：让两件物品对同一件事的记忆互相矛盾。

works.title: Who AR You?
works.description: A Heads Up-style party game for players in the same room: a mystery character, an animal or a celebrity, floats above one player's head where everyone except them can see it, and they ask yes-or-no questions until they guess who they are. Built at Specs in the City NYC 2025 by Kshitij Kumar Parashar, Brian Chung, Liza Karimova and Timera.
works.description_zh: 一款面向同处一室玩家的派对游戏，玩法类似 Heads Up：一个神秘角色（动物或名人）漂浮在某位玩家头顶，除了他本人谁都看得见；他通过提出是非题来猜出自己是谁。作品由 Kshitij Kumar Parashar、Brian Chung、Liza Karimova 和 Timera 在 Specs in the City NYC 2025 黑客松上完成。
works.idea_en: Shared AR is at its best when it shows everyone something except the person it is about.
works.idea_zh: 共享 AR 最妙的用法，是让所有人都看到某样东西，唯独当事人看不到。
works.technique: Sync Kit and a co-located session align all players' coordinate frames, the character model is bound to the guesser's head position, and it is hidden only in the guesser's own Lens.
works.technique_zh: Sync Kit 和同场会话对齐所有玩家的坐标系，角色模型绑定在猜题者的头部位置，并且只在猜题者自己的 Lens 中隐藏。
works.exercise_en: With two phones in a shared AR session (or a phone strapped to a headband), float a word above one player's head that only the others can read, and play three rounds. Twist: everyone wears a hidden character at once and players must trade clues.
works.exercise_zh: 用两部手机建立共享 AR 会话（或者把手机绑在头带上），在一位玩家头顶浮现一个只有别人能看到的词，玩三轮。变体：所有人头上同时都有隐藏角色，大家必须互相交换线索。

works.title: The Time Dial
works.description: A wearable time radio: turn a dial on a custom wristwatch to tune into a year, and historical photographs taken at that location appear around you at the places they were shot, while haptics nudge you toward nearby hotspots. The prototype drew on Boston Public Library's Digital Commonwealth archive. Built at MIT Reality Hack 2026 by Steven Harmon, Syed Akbar, Sara Jakubowicz, Ryan Bose-Roy and Alex Diviney.
works.description_zh: 一台可穿戴的“时间收音机”：转动定制腕表上的旋钮调到某一年，在这个地点拍摄的历史照片就会出现在你周围、出现在它们当年被拍下的位置，触觉振动还会引导你走向附近的热点。原型使用了波士顿公共图书馆 Digital Commonwealth 档案。作品由 Steven Harmon、Syed Akbar、Sara Jakubowicz、Ryan Bose-Roy 和 Alex Diviney 在 MIT Reality Hack 2026 完成。
works.idea_en: Tune a place to a different year like a radio station, and let its old photographs reappear where they were taken.
works.idea_zh: 像调收音机一样把一个地方调到另一个年份，让旧照片回到它们被拍下的位置。
works.technique: An ESP32 watch dial sends the selected date over WebSocket; matching geotagged, timestamped archive photos are pulled from Snap Cloud and placed with World Mesh, World Query and spatial anchors.
works.technique_zh: ESP32 腕表旋钮通过 WebSocket 发送所选日期；系统从 Snap Cloud 拉取带地理标记和时间戳的对应档案照片，并借助 World Mesh、World Query 和空间锚点放置它们。
works.exercise_en: Collect ten dated old photos of your campus, place each in phone AR at the spot where it was taken, and use a physical knob or an on-screen dial to filter by decade. Twist: each student adds a photo of the same spot taken today.
works.exercise_zh: 收集十张标有日期的校园老照片，用手机 AR 把每张放回拍摄地点，再用实体旋钮或屏幕上的转盘按年代筛选。变体：每位同学在同一地点拍一张今天的照片加进去。

works.title: Postmark
works.description: Spatial postcards: the sender captures a photo and records a short voice message, and the recipient places the resulting postcard on a fridge, wall or desk; when they look at it the image comes alive and the voice plays, and when they look away it waits quietly. Third place at the 3EALITY & Spectacles Hackathon in Amsterdam, by Markus Lanxinger, Marco van Nieuwenhoven and Jiayao Yu.
works.description_zh: 空间明信片：寄件人拍一张照片并录一段简短语音，收件人把生成的明信片贴在冰箱、墙上或书桌上；看向它时，画面动起来、声音响起；移开目光，它就静静待在原处。作品获阿姆斯特丹 3EALITY & Spectacles 黑客松第三名，由 Markus Lanxinger、Marco van Nieuwenhoven 和 Jiayao Yu 完成。
works.idea_en: A message that arrives in a place, and speaks only when you look at it.
works.idea_zh: 一条“抵达某个地方”的消息，只在你看向它时才开口。
works.technique: Each postcard is packaged in the cloud as an image, an audio clip and metadata and shared via a link; the recipient anchors it locally, and gaze dwell triggers playback with spatialised audio.
works.technique_zh: 每张明信片以图像、音频和元数据打包存到云端并通过链接分享；收件人在本地锚定它，注视停留会触发播放，声音为空间化音频。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR postcard: a photo plus a recorded voice note anchored to a real surface that plays only when the camera centre rests on it for two seconds; exchange cards in pairs. Twist: the postcard fades a little each time it is played.
works.exercise_zh: 做一张手机 AR 明信片：照片加一段录音，锚定在真实表面上，只有镜头中心在它上面停留两秒才播放；两人一组互相交换。变体：明信片每被播放一次就淡去一点。

works.title: Historic NBA shot charts on any court
works.description: Stand on any real basketball court and the Lens replays where every shot was taken in legendary NBA games, drawn onto the actual court around you, so history plays out on the ground where you stand. Made by Bob Bjarke of The Electric Factory for Snap and featured on Snap's Spectacles developer channel.
works.description_zh: 站在任何一块真实的篮球场上，Lens 都会把 NBA 传奇比赛中每一次出手的位置画在你脚下的场地上，让历史在你所站的地面上重演。作品由 The Electric Factory 的 Bob Bjarke 为 Snap 制作，并在 Snap 官方 Spectacles 开发者频道展示。
works.idea_en: Overlay historic data on the place it belongs to, so you can stand inside a famous game.
works.idea_zh: 把历史数据叠回它所属的场地上，让你站进一场著名比赛之中。
works.technique: Shot-chart coordinates from historic games are mapped onto a standard court template, which is aligned to the real court (likely by placing or detecting its corners) and rendered as markers on the ground plane.
works.technique_zh: 把历史比赛的投篮坐标映射到标准球场模板上，再将模板与真实球场对齐（很可能通过放置或识别球场角点），以标记形式渲染在地面上。
works.exercise_en: Take a public dataset tied to a standard space (a football pitch, a chessboard, a running track), align it in phone AR to a real one and visualise one famous event. Twist: let users play against the historic data, for example by shooting from the same spot.
works.exercise_zh: 找一份与标准场地相关的公开数据集（足球场、棋盘、跑道），在手机 AR 中把它对齐到真实场地，并可视化一场著名赛事。变体：让用户与历史数据对战，比如从同一个位置投篮。

works.title: TransitView
works.description: Stand at a stop and see timetables and routes floating in the street, plus the real-time positions of approaching buses and trams drawn in AR even while they are still hidden behind buildings; it covers the Netherlands and Berlin. Second place in Spectacles Community Challenge #13 and first in the Lens Update category of #15; the Berlin version won the Visitor Companion track at XRCC Berlin 2026.
works.description_zh: 站在车站，你能看到悬浮在街道上的时刻表和线路，还能看到即将到站的公交和电车的实时位置在 AR 中被画出来，即使它们还被楼房挡着；目前覆盖荷兰和柏林。作品获得 Spectacles Community Challenge #13 新 Lens 组第二名和 #15 更新组第一名，柏林版本还获得 XRCC Berlin 2026 Visitor Companion 赛道第一名。
works.idea_en: X-ray vision for public transport: see the bus coming around the corner before it appears.
works.idea_zh: 公共交通的透视眼：在公交车拐过街角之前就看到它。
works.technique: GPS and compass heading place the wearer in the city, open transit feeds supply stops, routes and real-time vehicle positions, and each vehicle is rendered at its geographic bearing and distance from the wearer.
works.technique_zh: GPS 和指南针朝向确定佩戴者在城市中的位置，开放交通数据提供站点、线路和车辆实时位置，每辆车按其相对佩戴者的地理方位和距离渲染出来。
works.exercise_en: Use a city's open real-time transit API with a phone's GPS and compass to draw an arrow and distance label toward the next bus in phone AR or WebXR. Twist: show the bus only as a sound that grows louder as it approaches, with no visuals.
works.exercise_zh: 用某个城市的开放实时公交 API，加上手机的 GPS 和指南针，在手机 AR 或 WebXR 中画出指向下一班公交的箭头和距离标签。变体：不显示画面，只用一个随公交靠近而变响的声音来表示它。

works.title: Memory Grid
works.description: A grid of tiles is laid on your real floor and a safe path lights up once; you must memorise it and then physically walk it, and one wrong step sends you back to the start. Eleven levels lengthen the path. Second place in the New Lens category of Spectacles Community Challenge #10.
works.description_zh: 一张格子网铺在真实地板上，一条安全路径只亮起一次；你得记住它，然后亲自一步步走过去，踩错一格就回到起点。共 11 关，路径越来越长。获得 Spectacles Community Challenge #10 新 Lens 组第二名。
works.idea_en: Make memory a full-body task by asking the player to walk the answer instead of tapping it.
works.idea_zh: 让玩家用双脚走出答案而不是点出答案，把记忆变成一项全身运动。
works.technique: The floor plane is found with world understanding, a tile grid is anchored to it, and the wearer's head position projected onto the floor decides which tile they are standing on.
works.technique_zh: 通过环境理解找到地面并在上面锚定格子网，再把佩戴者的头部位置投影到地面，判断他正踩在哪一格。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR floor grid where the phone's position decides the current tile; show a path for three seconds, then let a classmate walk it. Twist: play the path as a melody instead of showing it, so players must listen and walk.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 地面格子网，用手机的位置判断当前所在的格子；先显示路径三秒，再让同学走一遍。变体：路径不显示，而是用一段旋律播放出来，玩家要边听边走。

leads.name: Nithin Shankar
leads.why: Spectacles Community Challenge winner: Fork Fighter (#9 runner-up) uses a real fork as the controller for a tabletop mixed reality game; also Catch Up (#15 3rd) and Globe Trotter. No YouTube video found; try X or LinkedIn.

leads.name: Sitan Doucara
leads.why: DOT TO DOT (Challenge #12 runner-up) turns a real sheet of paper and a real pencil into an AR connect-the-dots puzzle with an animated reveal. No public video found yet.

leads.name: GrowPile (Nikola Kazakov & Manuel Nikolov)
leads.why: The Heist (Challenge #9 1st): the Spectacles wearer cracks a safe while friends on phones read the manual and guide them through a live bodycam stream; also Hexenfurt Memories. Repo public, no video found.

leads.name: Guillaume Dagens (DGNS)
leads.why: Prolific Spectacles developer: DGNS World FX (GLSL shaders projected onto the room), Pocket Garage (scan real cars into trading cards), CartDB (Lensathon 2025 2nd), Surf Sessions (finger surfing). Has a YouTube channel.

leads.name: Mouth Cannon Crew (Hart Woolery, Sallia Goldstein, Ben Knutson & Ruya Baraz)
leads.why: Tongue Topple won the Lensathon 2025 Games track with a custom tongue-tip tracking ML model used to aim; a Snapchat phone Lens rather than Spectacles.

leads.name: BallAR team
leads.why: CalHacks 12.0 1st place: AR beer-pong coach on Spectacles that uses electrical muscle stimulation pads to move the player's arm. Verified video Kqn162iM-P0.

leads.name: Ghost Gait team
leads.why: Reality Hack x Snap at AWE 2025: explores ritualised, slightly uncanny discomfort as social feedback in wearable AR; the listed Vimeo video does not play.

leads.name: Kavin Kumar (RBKAVIN studio)
leads.why: Projection Mapping Portal (Challenge #14 open source 2nd): pinch the four corners of a projected image and Spectacles head tracking turns it into a parallax window into another space; also Spatial Mapper. Repo public, no video found.

leads.name: Sylvan Shen
leads.why: Lumia Combat (Challenge #13 open source 2nd): harvest colours from real objects and throw them at a real Philips Hue lamp, which only takes damage from the complementary hue. Demo video is only on Google Drive.
